key_concepts: Materials thrown away can become bent, crumpled, torn, wet, dirty, spoiled, rotten, broken
Burning household materials makes them hot and produces smoke.
Improper trash disposal can harm people's health and safety.
Burning household materials can cause burns and breathing difficulties.
Harmful changes in materials can affect animals and plants.
Harmful changes can affect air, water, and soil.
The environment includes air, water, soil, animals, and plants.
Some old materials like glass bottles and tires are hard.
Empty tin cans and old utensils are shiny; plastic bags are stretchable.
A junk shop is a place where old materials are dumped and sorted.
People throw away or burn things they no longer need, to clean homes, or make space.
Not all trash can be sold in kalakal.
